findings.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:15 — FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale on every I18n.translate/backend fallback lookup (not just per-request), introducing a new DB dependency into a previously DB-free code path (rake tasks, console, background jobs, early boot) that can raise if the DB/site_settings table isn't ready

app/controllers/application_controller.rb:159 — I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` runs on every request via the `set_locale` before_filter, and each call rebuilds a fresh `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` array (config/initializers/i18n.rb:16) with no memoization, adding avoidable per-request allocation and a second `SiteSetting.default_locale` lookup (already fetched on the line above).
config/initializers/i18n.rb:11 — FallbackLocaleList#[] fallback chain ordering (locale -> SiteSetting.default_locale -> :en, with uniq/compact dedup) has no spec covering it.
lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb:62 — New I18n::Backend::Simple#ensure_loaded! method (guards @loaded_locales and calls load_locale) is untested.

app/controllers/application_controller.rb:158 — set_locale now calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! on every request with no controller/request spec asserting fallback translations actually load or that requests still succeed when a locale file is missing.
config/initializers/i18n.rb:15 — No test for edge case where SiteSetting.default_locale equals the requested locale or equals :en, which should collapse the fallback chain via uniq.

config/cloud/cloud66/files/production.rb:26 — Removal of config.i18n.fallbacks = true in favor of the custom I18n.fallbacks assignment is a behavioral change with no regression test ensuring translations still fall back correctly in production-like config load.

config/initializers/i18n.rb:12 — FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash to override only `[]`, inheriting the full mutable Hash API (merge!, store, delete, etc.) it doesn't need, when a plain object/module implementing `[]` and `ensure_loaded!` would express the intent without the unused surface area.

config/initializers/i18n.rb:20 — ensure_loaded!` and `[]` are only proven to work for the single call site in application_controller.rb; since I18n::Backend::Fallbacks expects `I18n.fallbacks` to behave like a Hash returning an array of locales for any key, this class only "happens to work" rather than fulfilling a documented Hash-like contract, e.g. `fetch`, `each`, or `default` semantics used elsewhere in the gem are unverified.

goldens.comment: The @loaded_locales instance variable in translate_accelerator.rb is lazily initialized and accessed by multiple concurrent threads without synchronization.

Consider normalizing the input locale (e.g., to a symbol) when checking/loading here to avoid double-loading if the same locale is passed as a String vs Symbol (also applies to other locations in the PR).

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:15 — FallbackLocaleList#[] calls SiteSetting.default_locale on every I18n.translate/backend fallback lookup (not just per-request), introducing a new DB dependency into a previously DB-free code path (rake tasks, console, background jobs, early boot) that can raise if the DB/site_settings table isn't ready

adjudication.rationale: The new initializer defines `FallbackLocaleList#[]` to build the fallback chain as `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]` (config/initializers/i18n.rb:15-20). That means every fallback resolution will invoke `SiteSetting.default_locale`, which is a new runtime dependency compared to the prior `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` setting removed from environment configs. The diff does not prove `SiteSetting.default_locale` hits the DB or will raise during boot/tasks, but it does show a potentially problematic global fallback hook now calling into application settings code on each lookup.

adjudication_records.issue_text: app/controllers/application_controller.rb:159 — I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` runs on every request via the `set_locale` before_filter, and each call rebuilds a fresh `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` array (config/initializers/i18n.rb:16) with no memoization, adding avoidable per-request allocation and a second `SiteSetting.default_locale` lookup (already fetched on the line above).

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` inside `ApplicationController#set_locale` (app/controllers/application_controller.rb), so whenever `set_locale` is invoked it will call `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!`, which calls `self[I18n.locale]` and thereby allocates a new `[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en].uniq.compact` array each time (config/initializers/i18n.rb). This is a concrete per-call allocation and repeats a `SiteSetting.default_locale` lookup already used in `set_locale`; it's a performance/efficiency concern rather than a correctness bug. The assertion that it runs 'on every request via before_filter' is plausible but not directly shown in the provided diff context.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/cloud/cloud66/files/production.rb:26 — Removal of config.i18n.fallbacks = true in favor of the custom I18n.fallbacks assignment is a behavioral change with no regression test ensuring translations still fall back correctly in production-like config load.

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes `config.i18n.fallbacks = true` from multiple production-like configs and replaces it with a custom `I18n.fallbacks = FallbackLocaleList.new` initializer that changes fallback order (`[locale, SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, :en]`) and adds runtime loading via `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` in `ApplicationController#set_locale`. No test changes appear in the diff to lock in the expected fallback behavior after this nontrivial change, so a targeted regression test would be a reasonable review request.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:12 — FallbackLocaleList subclasses Hash to override only `[]`, inheriting the full mutable Hash API (merge!, store, delete, etc.) it doesn't need, when a plain object/module implementing `[]` and `ensure_loaded!` would express the intent without the unused surface area.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `class FallbackLocaleList < Hash` in `config/initializers/i18n.rb` and only overrides `[]` plus adds `ensure_loaded!`, without using any Hash storage. Subclassing `Hash` implicitly exposes mutation methods (e.g., `merge!`, `store`, `delete`) that aren’t needed for this role and could allow unintended state changes to `I18n.fallbacks`. A plain object implementing `[]`/`ensure_loaded!` would better match the intended immutable, computed fallback list behavior. This is a design/maintenance concern rather than a directly verifiable runtime defect in the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: config/initializers/i18n.rb:20 — ensure_loaded!` and `[]` are only proven to work for the single call site in application_controller.rb; since I18n::Backend::Fallbacks expects `I18n.fallbacks` to behave like a Hash returning an array of locales for any key, this class only "happens to work" rather than fulfilling a documented Hash-like contract, e.g. `fetch`, `each`, or `default` semantics used elsewhere in the gem are unverified.

adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `FallbackLocaleList < Hash` overriding only `[]` (and adding `ensure_loaded!`) and assigns it to `I18n.fallbacks`. While `Hash` does provide `fetch`, `each`, `default`, etc., overriding `[]` alone may not affect other lookup methods (e.g., `fetch`), so if `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` (or other code) uses non-`[]` access patterns, the custom fallback behavior might not apply. The diff itself only shows one call site (`I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` in `ApplicationController#set_locale`) and doesn’t demonstrate broader compatibility, so this is a concrete design/contract risk but not a verifiable broken behavior from the diff alone.
